Talent0_2Ability.name: Field-Tested
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: After being actively attacked, if HP is below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, immediately triggers <color=#F74848>1</color> Manipulator passive repair effect after combat. Gains <buf ID=1016502>[Heroism I]</buf> based on current HP lost, gaining <color=#F74848>1</color> stack for every <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP lost. Can stack up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Field-Tested
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
After being actively attacked, if HP is below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, immediately triggers <color=#F74848>1</color> Manipulator passive repair effect after combat. Gains <buf ID=1016502>[Heroism I]</buf> based on current HP lost, gaining <color=#F74848>1</color> stack for every <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP lost. Can stack up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times.
When a repair effect is triggered by the talent, can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. When deployed, gains <buf ID=1016514>[Absolute Will]</buf>.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101602.name: Battlefield Regroup
101602.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900127>[Heroism]</buf>, repair multiplier is increased by <color=#F74848>0.1</color>.

101603.name: Hidden Fangs
101603.SpecificEffects: During combat, if this unit's HP percentage is lower than the target's, Crit Rate and Crit DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

101604.name: Double-Edged Saw
101604.describe:
Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.35</color> DMG. This attack always hits the body part.
Before combat, reduces own HP by <color=#F74848>20%</color> of max HP from all parts, then deals <color=#F74848>20%</color> of target max HP as <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>. The HP reduction as well as the <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> cannot destroy any part.

101605.name: Rising Morale
101605.SpecificEffects: When triggering talent's repair effect, dispels <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff from self.

101606.name: Finishing Strike
101606.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.8x</color> DMG. For each stack of <buf ID=900127>[Heroism]</buf>, damage multiplier is increased by <color=#F74848>0.15</color>.

101607.name: Counter Master
101607.SpecificEffects: During the Enemy Turn, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.

101608.name: Zero Hour
101608.describe: Deducts HP from all of own parts equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of their Max HP, without destroying any parts, and gains <color=#F74848>3</color> AP and <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf> for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Can then trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> and move using full Movement.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy’s attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

101641.name: The Exiled 1
101641.SpecificEffects: With a Chainsaw, if unable to retaliate in combat, <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> can trigger, allowing the unit to move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles toward the attacker after combat. If successfully reached the target, uses Chainsaw to launch a <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.8</color> DMG. Returns to original position after trigger.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101644.name: The Exiled 2
101644.SpecificEffects: At the end of action, if <buf ID=900127>[Heroism]</buf> stacks are <color=#F74848>5</color> or more, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

101646.name: The Exiled 4
101646.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900127>[Heroism]</buf> maximum stacks increase by <color=#F74848>3</color>, each stack additionally increases Final DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>4%</color>.

hiddenSkills.name: Critical Smash
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> DMG. This attack always hits the part with lowest HP.
